candidate_identity.b1: Exactly 100 unique source SHA-256 identities in rank order; top20_binding_sha256 binds cell, prompt hash and the ordered first 20 identities.
candidate_identity.b2: Exactly the persisted B1 Top-20 for persisted_candidate_source, same order at input and same identity set after reranking; per-candidate view and whole reranker input hashes are mandatory.
candidate_identity.hard_failure_policy: A SUCCESS row may include retry/timeout/failure attempt costs. An unrecovered outcome produces no scientific row and blocks complete-scope scoring; it is not represented by invented ranks.

endpoints.acceptable_known_a: All 1,077 prompts, credit for any member of frozen A_q.
endpoints.strict_singleton: Only final_label_type STRICT prompts, where frozen A_q has exactly one member; no designated strict target is invented for multi-acceptable prompts.
endpoints.unknown: U_q equals library minus J_q; unjudged is not counted as error.
endpoints.reviewed_error: Top-1 in J_q minus A_q, decomposed into PARTIALLY_ADEQUATE and INADEQUATE.
endpoints.identification_interval: [Known-A Hit@1, Known-A Hit@1 + Unjudged@1], distinct from a confidence interval.

statistics.estimand: prompt-weighted paired difference within the NC primary scope
statistics.sensitivity: Equal-dependency-group-weighted point estimate is reported beside the prompt-weighted primary estimate.
